response.sql: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT CENTROMEA AS status, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb, AVG(`T-BIL` / NULLIF(CRE, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Laboratory WHERE Date BETWEEN '1985-04-22' AND '1994-03-14' GROUP BY CENTROMEA), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM status_averages) SELECT status, avg_hgb, avg_ratio, avg_ratio / mean_ratio AS ratio_to_mean FROM status_averages CROSS JOIN overall WHERE mean_ratio IS NOT NULL
